differences: The paper's mixed-effects results (MATLAB fitlme with by-speaker and by-word slopes) were not refitted; the checks are counts and two Pearson correlations (r = 0.84 and 0.70 as printed) computed after the 1st-99th percentile trimming the paper describes.

17 tokens have a negative plateau duration (a target landmark after the release landmark; 33 are not positive, 16 of them exactly 0) and 2 have a negative movement amplitude; they are the authors' values and are kept.

The OSF project states no license (the article itself is CC BY 4.0). The authors' COns, CTarg, CRel and COff columns hold implausible values for the four AG501 speakers (negative, up to -19) and are not carried. The paper says tongue tip height was measured; the deposit's TT_Z trace was identical to the vertical component of the tongue tip in all AG501 rows.
